questions.question: A prophet told Judah that only a few of its towns had been carried into exile. True or false?
The prophet asked if the Ethiopian can change his skin or the leopard his spots. What was he saying about Judah?

answers.text: They can't do good when they're used to evil
They will change once the trouble comes
They are no worse than the other nations

questions.question: The LORD told Judah that being scattered was their lot. What reason did He give for it?

answers.text: They forgot Him and trusted in falsehood
They doubted Him and trusted in Egypt
They envied the nations and trusted in armies

questions.question: After the LORD said "Woe to you" to Jerusalem through the prophet, what did He ask the city?

answers.text: How long it will remain unclean
Why it went back to Egypt
